topic: They plan a birthday surprise for their human friend Sara.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: Sara’s Birthday Surprise

shots.narration: Could one tangled ribbon spoil Sara’s birthday surprise?
shots.scene: Cosy colourful living room, tangled yellow ribbon beside a blank wrapped present, warm sunlight, rounded 3D family-film styling, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno lifts one ribbon end, revealing a tangled clump beneath it.
shots.mood: Golden-brown floppy ears, puzzled eyes, bright yellow loops filling the foregrou

shots.narration: Mishi had planned a special birthday table for Sara.
shots.scene: Low living-room table with a small frosted birthday cake, unlit candles, colourful paper flowers and an empty gift space, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi slides the plain wrapped present beside the cake.
shots.mood: Fluffy grey fur, green eyes, red ear bow, neatly arranged pastel decorations.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Bruno’s ribbon looked more like a noodle nest!
shots.scene: Soft living-room rug beside the birthday table, yellow ribbon piled on the floor, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno tilts his head at the ribbon clump.
shots.mood: One floppy ear hanging sideways, blue collar and bone-shaped tag, comically rais

shots.narration: Mishi spotted one loose end beneath the loops.
shots.scene: Sunlit rug with the tangled ribbon between the two friends, birthday table behind them, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi points one grey paw at the loose ribbon end.
shots.mood: Focused green eyes, a clearly visible yellow ribbon tip, Bruno watching closely.

shots.narration: Bruno tried pulling, but the tangle only tightened.
shots.scene: Living-room floor beside the low birthday table, ribbon clump centered between the friends, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno pulls the wrong ribbon loop into a tighter bunch.
shots.mood: Small puckered ribbon knot, Bruno’s surprised eyebrows, Mishi’s attentive expres

shots.narration: [sighs] Perhaps gentle paws would work better than strong pulls.
shots.scene: Warm living-room rug with the yellow ribbon resting flat, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno releases the ribbon from beneath his paw.
shots.mood: Relaxed paws, softened puppy expression, Mishi sitting patiently nearby.

shots.narration: Mishi held the loose end steady.
shots.scene: Close floor-level view of the ribbon’s loose end and tangled loops on a soft rug, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi pins the loose ribbon end gently beneath one paw.
shots.mood: Careful grey paw, bright yellow ribbon, Bruno poised beside the remaining loops.

shots.narration: Bruno carefully unwound the loops, one by one.
shots.scene: Open rug space between the sofa and birthday table, ribbon extending from Mishi’s stationary paw, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno gently draws the final loose loop out of the tangle.
shots.mood: Smooth ribbon stretching across the rug, Bruno’s concentrated face, warm golden

shots.narration: [excited] Together, they finally had one lovely ribbon!
shots.scene: Living-room rug in front of the decorated birthday table, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno stretch the straightened ribbon between their paws.
shots.mood: Matching proud smiles, flowing yellow ribbon, colourful birthday decorations ove

shots.narration: Mishi added the finishing touch to Sara’s present.
shots.scene: Low birthday table with frosted cake, paper flowers and a blank wrapped present encircled by yellow ribbon, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi presses a large matching bow onto the present.
shots.mood: Plump yellow bow, Mishi’s pleased green eyes, Bruno’s admiring smile.

shots.narration: Now Sara’s birthday surprise was ready!
shots.scene: Completed birthday table beside an open garden doorway, cake with unlit candles, wrapped gift and paper flowers, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno present the birthday table with outstretched paws.
shots.mood: Big welcoming smiles, festive colours, sunny garden glowing beyond the doorway.

shots.narration: [whispers] Teamwork makes surprises sweeter; next, a mysterious garden trail!
shots.scene: Open doorway beside the birthday table, a winding trail of pink petals crossing the sunny garden path, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi points toward the petal trail while Bruno watches beside her.
shots.mood: Curious green eyes, lifted floppy ears, inviting pink petals disappearing behind

episode.endHook: Where does the mysterious garden petal trail lead?
episode.description: Mishi and Bruno prepare a birthday surprise for their human friend Sara, but a tangled ribbon slows them down. A little teamwork turns their twisty problem into something lovely!
